promptPrefix: Use case: illustration-story. Create one standalone production website illustration asset, not a webpage or mockup. The attached screenshot is the visual reference: reproduce ONLY the large illustration at the LEFT of its DESKTOP view. Match its hand-painted watercolor/gouache storybook rendering closely: refined thin brown linework, intricate golden Thai gables, muted sage foliage, red wood trim, warm pale stone, cream clouds, soft sand grounding. Preserve the reference's arrangement, scale and character.
promptSuffix: Landscape canvas 4:3. Center the COMPLETE illustration, filling about 94% of the canvas width and 92% height with a little breathing room. Entire scene is a clean isolated vignette with a TRANSPARENT alpha background, no opaque rectangle, no border, no UI, no error number, no buttons, no header/footer, no watermark, no new extra decorative subjects. Retain the small pale clouds and ground wash within the vignette. The only permitted words are the wooden sign text requested above, correctly spelled Thai. This is one coherent illustration.
